logline: 빵 한 조각으로 십구 년을 살고 나온 남자가, 하룻밤 재워 준 집의 은그릇을 훔친다.
destination: 주교의 식탁 — 그가 다시 붙들려 오는 자리
protagonist: 짧게 깎은 머리에 누런 죄수 옷을 걸친 마흔 살 사내
setting: 1810년대 프랑스 시골 마을과 주교의 검소한 집
anchor: a hard-faced man of forty, cropped hair, coarse yellow prison coat, heavy boots
palette: cold stone grey, warm amber, road dust ochre, deep night blue

valjean.label: 장발장
valjean.desc: a hard-faced French man of forty, cropped grey-flecked hair, coarse yellow coat, worn boots, canvas sack

bishop.label: 주교
bishop.desc: a slight white-haired French priest in his seventies, simple black cassock, small pectoral cross, calm face
bishop.avoid: 화려한 주교관·금란 예복은 이 인물의 것이 아니다

gendarmes.label: 헌병들
gendarmes.desc: two French gendarmes in dark blue coats with white cross-belts, black bicorne hats, sabres at the hip

bishop_house.label: 주교의 집
bishop_house.desc: a plain whitewashed room, bare table, two wooden chairs, low ceiling beams

beats.beat: 사내가 감옥 문을 나서 흙길에 선다.
beats.visual: a hard-faced man in a yellow coat stepping out of a studded prison door onto a dusty road
beats.motion: the door swings shut behind him, he walks forward down the road, dust lifts at his boots

beats.visual: an inn door shut in the face of a man in a yellow coat, shutters closing above him
beats.motion: the door slams toward him, a shutter bangs closed overhead, he steps back

beats.visual: a white-haired priest seating a rough man at a bare table in a plain whitewashed room
beats.motion: the priest draws the chair out toward him, soup steams on the table, the lamp flame dips

beats.visual: a man in a yellow coat sweeping silver plates into a canvas sack in a dark room
beats.motion: the plates slide into the sack, his shadow swings across the wall, a shutter creaks

beats.visual: two gendarmes marching a bound man in a yellow coat up a village lane at dawn
beats.motion: they push him forward up the lane, his sack swings from a gendarme's fist, dust rises

beats.visual: a white-haired priest holding out two tall silver candlesticks to a rough man in a yellow coat held between two gendarmes
beats.motion: the candlesticks come forward toward the man, the gendarmes' hands fall open, dust turns

beats.beat: 사내가 두 손으로 촛대를 받아 든다.
beats.visual: a rough man in a yellow coat cupping two silver candlesticks in both hands, doorway light behind
beats.motion: his hands close around them, his head lowers, morning light widens behind him

beats.visual: a bare wooden table in an empty whitewashed room, two chairs pushed back, morning light
beats.motion: morning light creeps across the table, dust turns in the beam, a shutter stirs

withheld: 장발장이 이름을 바꾸고 시장이 되는 것과, 그를 끝까지 쫓는 자베르와의 결말
